item.title: Insider PowerToys version tricks the Microsoft store into thinking that PowerToys is not installed
item.author: ReginaldTang

judgment.rationale: Only a screenshot is provided; 0.101.2432 is an Insider/prerelease build, so Store ownership may be expected channel separation or a package identity bug depending on install source.
evidence: Reported build is 0.101.2432 Insider with Microsoft Store selected.
Live release list shows 0.101.2432.0 as prerelease.
Installer metadata includes package identity MSIX and PowerToys (Preview) naming.
judgment.recommended_action: Request exact Insider install source and package identity/Store state evidence.

fix_assessment.rationale: A packaging fix is plausible only if Insider is intended to preserve Store ownership; current evidence is insufficient.

issue_context.summary: After moving to an Insider PowerToys build, Microsoft Store appears to no longer recognize PowerToys as installed.
known_information: Only repro step is updating to Insider.
No bug report ZIP or package identity output.
inferences: Store may track stable Store package while Insider/GitHub preview uses different identity/installer metadata.
issue_context.analysis: Need intended Store/Insider ownership contract and package identity before proposing code/design.
initial_investigation: Checked live release list and installer package identity search.

information_gaps.information: Exact source used to install/update Insider and package identity shown afterward.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes expected channel separation from packaging identity regression.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: State whether Insider came from Store, GitHub, winget, or app updater; then comment /bugreport after opening the Store page.

actions.label: Confirm Insider install source and package identity

comment.body: The screenshot shows Store no longer recognizing PowerToys after moving to `0.101.2432 Insider`, which is a prerelease build. Please confirm whether the Insider build was installed from Microsoft Store, GitHub, winget, or PowerToys auto-update. Then open the Store page showing PowerToys as not installed and comment `/bugreport` so package identity and installer/update state are captured.
